page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 196 left. Heading block at top (German line, then a centred title). A tree diagram (division of Urticae) occupies the upper half, with boxed branches and brace structures. Below it, a left column holds an engraving with its caption, and a right column of running text with German and Gallic lines continuing across the full width. Below the engraving, a full-width italic caption, then a second engraving with its own caption and the running head "VRTICA" at lower right.

main_text.l: GERMANICE
quidam interpretantur Seheflam/ Mehrflam. Licebit etiam Seenessel appellare.
VRTICARVM DIVISIO EX RONDELETII SENTENTIA: cui confecta
singularum Germanica nomina addidimus.
Vrticarum aliae
Semper adhaerent Klåbneslen
Saxis, Steinnessel: ut Simpliciter ein Seenessel/
oder ein kleine Seenessel. Editur.
Vrtica parua, Cul d'Asne Normanis.
Testis alienis, praeserti-
m Purpuris & buccinis: species innominata. ein Schnecknes sel. non editur.
*Paruarum autem alia est: Caerulea. Viridis. Subnigra,
sed notata cæruleis
pūctis, uel flauis, nigris.
Cinerea: cirris multis semper explicat-
is: carnis parum habet. ein âschfarbe
Seenessel.
Pro arbitrio haerent, aut solutae uagantur: ut rubra Vrtica:
ein rote Seenessel.
Semper solutae libereque sunt eae, quas Galli uulgò Potes appellant, Albertus Stincos.
Ein Meerscham/ein Meerhûr. Ex his pedes siue brachia habet: Species una, quatuor.
Altera, octo: Polypi brachiis
nō ualde dissimilia.
VRTICA prima seu parua Rondeletij. Nucis
iuglandis (inquit) magnitudinem uix superat, ob
id parua à nobis dicitur. Harum aliae uirides sunt, aliae caeruleae:
aliae subnigrae, sed punctis aliquot caeruleis, uel flauis, uel
rubris notatae. In Oceani saxis frequentes sunt, apud
Santones ac Burdegalenses in deliciis. ¶ Scopulis litoralibus
tam pertinaciter inhaeret, ut nisi primo impetu diuellatur,
uix postea, nisi in frusta cōcisa dirimi possit, adeo suas
trichas arctissimè contrahit, Bellonius.
GRAECIS uulgò Colycaena. Vide superius in
Vrticis in genere.
GALL. Massilienses Vrtigo uocant, Rondeletius.
Normanni Cul d'Asne, (id est, Podicem asini,) à cirrorum
contractione atqe explicatione, Bellonius.
GERMAN. Ein kleine Seenessel oder Seeflam. ein Arßnessel.
ein kleine Steinnessel/ von farben grün/ oder blaw/ oder schwartzlecht.
Eiusdem alia eicon à Bellonio propofita dupliciter: maior explicatam
Vrticam, minor contractam repraesentat.
Vrtica parua Rondeletij.

page.notes: The tree diagram's branch structure is reconstructed from the printed braces; the two engravings (a small urtica on rock, and a larger pair of sea anemones with a contracted and an expanded form) are not transcribed. Several German words in the Fraktur are uncertain and may contain misreadings, particularly "Klåbneslen", "Meerscham", "Meerhûr", "Arßnessel" and "âschfarbe".
